description: Source file implementing utility functions for decoding IAMF (Immersive Audio Metadata Format) buffers, including parsing OBU headers, codec configs, audio elements, and mix presentations, with focus on binaural and surround audio configurations.

classes.name: BufferReader
classes.description: A helper class for reading and parsing data from a byte buffer, supporting reading integers, strings, and LEB128 encoded values, with methods to skip bytes and check remaining data.

methods.name: ParseOBUHeader
methods.description: Parses an IAMF OBU header to extract the OBU type and size, handling flags for trimming and extension.

methods.name: ParseCodecConfigOBU
methods.description: Parses a codec configuration OBU to extract sample rate and number of samples, supporting Opus and ipcm codecs.

methods.name: CheckForAdvancedAudioElements
methods.description: Checks if an audio element contains binaural or surround configurations and sets corresponding IDs.

methods.name: ParseAudioElementOBU
methods.description: Parses an audio element OBU to extract its ID, type, and parameters, optionally identifying binaural and surround configurations.

methods.name: ParseMixPresentationOBU
methods.description: Parses a mix presentation OBU to determine the presentation ID based on preferences for binaural or surround audio.

methods.name: ParseDescriptorOBU
methods.description: Parses a descriptor OBU, dispatching to specific handlers based on OBU type, and updates buffer info accordingly.

methods.name: IamfBufferInfo::is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the IAMF buffer info contains valid data, including a valid mix presentation ID, sample rate, and number of samples.

methods.name: ParseInputBuffer
methods.description: Main function to parse an input buffer into IAMF buffer info, handling multiple OBUs and extracting configuration and data segments.
